usage: music-tagger apply [-h] --release-id RELEASE_ID
                          (--cover-file COVER_FILE | --keep-cover)
                          --genre GENRE [--force-genre] [--approve-overwrites]
                          [--ignore-locks] [--isrc {keep,musicbrainz}]
                          [--isrc-code [DISC-]TRACK=CODE] [--log LOG |
                          --no-log]
                          path

Run tag, art, genre, rename, and replaygain on an album, stopping at the first
failure. Inputs are checked before anything is written.

positional arguments:
  path                  Album directory.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --release-id RELEASE_ID
                        MusicBrainz release UUID.
  --cover-file COVER_FILE
                        Install and embed this reviewed image.
  --keep-cover          Embed the album's existing cover.* image.
  --genre GENRE         Genre to set. Repeat for several.
  --force-genre         Allow genres not on the canonical list.
  --approve-overwrites  Passed to `tag`.
  --ignore-locks        Passed to `tag`.
  --isrc {keep,musicbrainz}
                        Passed to `tag`.
  --isrc-code [DISC-]TRACK=CODE
                        Passed to `tag`.
  --log LOG             Append changes to this log file (default:
                        $MUSIC_TAGGER_LOG, else ~/Projects/music-
                        tagger/changes.log).
  --no-log              Do not write the change log.
